addendum_content_raw:
In Part VII of my Financial Disclosure Report, | listed Metropolitan West Total Return Bond Fund Plan Class, which was not listed on my 2013 report filed on

5/12/2014. 1 came into possession of this asset because the PIMCO Total Return Inst, Fund, which was listed on my 2013 report, was no longer offered, and the

company through which 1 have this retirement plan opted to substitute the Metropolitan West Fund for the PIMCO Fund. This Plan Exchange, which occurred on

December |, 2014, also accounts for the fact that the PIMCO Fund does not appear on this 2014 report. There was no change in value associated with the Plan

Exchange.

In Part VIL of my Financial Disclosure Report, | listed TDAM Money Market Portfolio Select, which was not listed on my 2013 report filed on 5/12/2014. 1

came into possession of this asset because the CNI Charter Prime Money Market Fund Inst, which was listed on my 2013 report, was proprietary to National

Financial Services. The company through which 1 have this retirement plan opted to transfer to TD Ameritrade, and this company-initiated change resulted in the

substitution of the TDAM Money Market asset for the ONI Charter Fund. This change, which occurred on January 22, 2015, also accounts for the fact that the

CNI Charter Fund does not appear on this 2014 report. There was no change in value associated with this change.

addendum_content_raw:
In Part VII of my Financial Disclosure Report, Item No. 4, | listed Vanguard Federal Money Market Investor, which was not listed on my 2015 Report, filed on

5/13/16. 1 came into possession of this asset as a result of the following series of transactions:

1. On September 28, 2016, TD Ameritrade changed the asset from TDAM Money Market Portfolio Select to FDIC Insured Deposit Account, My understanding

is that this TD Ameritrade-initiated change came about as a result of a change in SEC regulations that affected one's ability to obtain funds from money market

accounts in times of market volatility. There was no change in the value of the asset as a result of this change.

2. The company through which | have this retirement plan opted to transfer from TD Ameritrade to Charles Schwab on May 1, 2017, This company-initiated

change resulted in the substitution of & cash Personal Choice Retirement Account (PCRA), which did not change the value of the asset.

3. Effective May 16, 2017, | changed the PCRA to the Vanguard Federal Money Market Investor account with no change im the value of the asset.

This also explains why TDAM Money Market Portfolio Select, which appeared on my 2015 Report, does not appear on this 2016 Report.
